name: Bramble Scale Mail
summary: Scale mail that grows dull leaves and lets you hide in foliage.
description: The scales are overlapped in a pattern like a pine cone. Rangers have been known to wear it all winter.

stats.effect: You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. While you are in a forest or other area with heavy vegetation, you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
